description: Mobile techniques used by KoSpy, ATT&CK software S9048 (v1.0)
name: KoSpy (S9048)

techniques.comment: [KoSpy](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9048) has used an HTTP POST request with a payload in JSON format to obtain configuration data.(Citation: Lookout_KoSpy_March2025)
[KoSpy](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9048) has encrypted collected data with a hardcoded AES key.(Citation: Lookout_KoSpy_March2025)
[KoSpy](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9048) has recorded audio using dynamically loaded plugins.(Citation: Lookout_KoSpy_March2025)
[KoSpy](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9048) has been distributed via the third-party application store Apkpure.(Citation: Lookout_KoSpy_March2025)
[KoSpy](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9048) has accessed files and folders in the local storage using dynamically loaded plugins.(Citation: Lookout_KoSpy_March2025)
[KoSpy](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9048) has recorded keystrokes by abusing accessibility features.(Citation: Lookout_KoSpy_March2025)
[KoSpy](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9048) has collected the device’s location using dynamically loaded plugins.(Citation: Lookout_KoSpy_March2025)
[KoSpy](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9048) has masqueraded as legitimate applications, such as “File Manager, “Software Update Utility,” and “Kakao Security.”(Citation: Lookout_KoSpy_March2025)
[KoSpy](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9048) has encrypted and encoded values with Base64 during C2 communication initialization.
[KoSpy](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9048) has collected call logs using dynamically loaded plugins.(Citation: Lookout_KoSpy_March2025)
[KoSpy](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9048) has collected SMS messages using dynamically loaded plugins.(Citation: Lookout_KoSpy_March2025)
[KoSpy](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9048) has captured screenshots and recordings of the device screen using dynamically loaded plugins.(Citation: Lookout_KoSpy_March2025)
[KoSpy](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9048) has collected a list of installed applications using dynamically loaded plugins.(Citation: Lookout_KoSpy_March2025)
[KoSpy](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9048) has collected Wi-Fi network details using dynamically loaded plugins.(Citation: Lookout_KoSpy_March2025)
[KoSpy](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9048) has taken pictures with the device’s cameras using dynamically loaded plugins.(Citation: Lookout_KoSpy_March2025)
[KoSpy](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9048) has checked if the device is not an emulator and if the current date is past the hardcoded activation date.(Citation: Lookout_KoSpy_March2025)
[KoSpy](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9048) has used Firebase Firestore to receive configuration data: an “on”/”off” switch and the C2 server address.(Citation: Lookout_KoSpy_March2025)
